meta.method: Polymarket five-minute bars ending during March 1–28, 2026, for resolved binary markets. Adjacent archive days supply context only. Each hourly horizon uses the latest completed positive-volume trade bar at or before the cutoff, with bar-end age at most 30 minutes. Favorites must be priced at least 51%. Missing bars are never interpolated or carried beyond that age limit. Each contract contributes once per horizon.
meta.clockNote: The anchor is the source-reported close/expiry proxy, not independently verified event occurrence. A close can follow the public result. Price changes compare completed bar closes; actual trade timestamps within a bar may differ by up to the bar length. A 30-minute bar-age limit permits an actual last trade up to 35 minutes old.
meta.intervalNote: Approximate 95% Student-t intervals cluster contracts within archive-defined parent events. Suppressed below 20 events or at zero estimated variance. They exclude source error, event-clock error, dependence between different event IDs, and multiple-comparison adjustments.
meta.moveMethod: Endpoints must both be positive-volume trade bars with completion times exactly 15, 30 or 60 minutes apart. A candidate moves by at least 5 percentage points. Prices and the result are oriented toward the outcome whose price rose; that outcome need not be the favorite. Filter by the requested move size and minimum hours before close, then retain the earliest qualifying move and require at least six hours before another move in that contract. Forward prices do not affect selection.
meta.forwardMethod: For each one-, six- or 24-hour follow-up, use the last completed positive-volume trade bar at or before the follow-up, no more than five minutes old, only when the follow-up is at or before the source anchor. Missing follow-ups stay null. Reversal rates must use only their own available follow-up denominators.
meta.volumeMethod: Window volume sums active bar quantity strictly after the start endpoint through the end endpoint. Polymarket counts only shares of the tracked outcome token, not all trading in both tokens; Kalshi counts contracts. Neither is dollar turnover. Endpoint spreads, when present, are same-minute YES ask minus bid, with both quotes strictly inside zero and one; trade and quote closes need not be simultaneous.
meta.cohortWarning: These are different, selected archives. Do not pool the two source cohorts or compare their headline scores as if they forecast the same events.

sourceManifest.priceBasis: last trade in a five-minute bar
sourceManifest.volumeUnit: shares/contracts of the one tracked outcome, not dollar volume or all-outcome market volume
rules: Binary contracts only: exactly two outcome tokens, both settled, exactly one winner.
One fixed token per contract: YES when labeled, otherwise lowest outcome index. The choice never uses the realized outcome.
Bars require positive trade_count and volume, finite close in [0,1], and completion by the source anchor.
The entire five-minute bucket must be after market opening. No interpolation or carried-forward prices.
The source anchor is the earlier of recorded close and scheduled expiry; actual event occurrence is not independently verified.
Unresolved or conflicting binary outcomes in the source snapshot are excluded, so this is a resolved-contract historical cohort.
Detailed topics reuse the original Atlas mapping when available; unclassified mappings remain explicitly labeled.
Context days are not part of the forecast-date cohort and must only be used for backward or forward observations.
sourceManifest.normalizedSharding: Numeric market_id modulo 3. Each contract is wholly in one shard. Union all three shards without deduplicating.
